name: ECON 3321
title: Programming and Computation with R for Economists
description: Basics of R programming. Objects, data structures, logical design, functions. Applications to matrix algebra, optimization, data visualization, and econometric analysis.
requirement_description: ECON 2201 or 2211Q; ECON 2202 or 2212Q. Not open for credit to students who have passed ECON 5321.
